column2: Deep in the forest lived a girl named Ella, who wove winter nests for small animals from fallen leaves each day. One snowy night, she rescued a frozen bluebird. When the bird awoke, it repaid her by spitting out a glowing seed. Ella buried the seed in the moss, and by the next day, it had grown into a Crystal tree. Silver fruit hung among its branches like dewdrops, each reflecting what people desired most in their hearts.
column3: Deep in the forest lived a girl named Ella, who wove winter nests for small animals from fallen leaves each day. One snowy night, she rescued a frozen bluebird. When the bird awoke, it repaid her by spitting out a glowing seed. Ella buried the seed in the moss, and by the next day, it had grown into a Crystal tree. Silver fruit hung among its branches like dewdrops, each reflecting what people desired most in their hearts.

column2: When the greedy lord heard about it, he stormed into the forest with an axe. But as he struck the trunk, all the fruit suddenly shattered at once, reflecting thousands of disappointed eyes—the eyes of every impoverished person in his domain. The Crystal tree dissolved into mist, leaving only the plainest fruit to roll into Ella's hand. Within it was a vision of the entire forest flourishing.

column2: Ella finally understood. She gently buried the fruit beside the stream. In the morning light, glowing flowers bloomed all along the bank. They bore no fruit, but allowed everyone who passed to see their heart's true desire. From then on, no one in the forest fought over treasure, because everyone Discovered that the most precious magic had already quietly taken root within their hearts.

Guild Prestige Acquisition Rules:
@{1}.^{1}Guild Prestige represents a guild's Battle strength^{2}. It is not Cleared between Seasons. Every Season, all guilds across the server group are ranked by Prestige, and the results are Permanently Recorded.
@{2}.When Guild Members participate in guild battlefield modes—Guild Territory War (Stronghold War, Escort Battle, Regional Capital War/Royal City War)—their Defeats on the battlefield are converted into Guild Prestige.
@{3}.Victory or defeat in guild battlefield modes also affects the amount of Prestige awarded during Settlement.

column2:
Receive an invite Rules:
@{1}.Receiving a merge invite means ^{1}the other guild is inviting your guild to Merge into theirs^{2}.
@{2}.After accepting the merge invite, you must adjust the number of guild members who can Merge into the other guild so that it does not exceed the number of members they can accept.
@{3}.Once you have accepted the merge invite and adjusted the number of members who can merge, ^{3}the Merge Guild process will be completed at 5:00 a.m. the next day^{4}.
@{4}.Before the merge takes place, you can select [Cancel Merge] on the screen. The Merge Guild process will end immediately after it is canceled.
@{5}.If your guild's member count exceeds the number of members the other guild can accept when the merge takes place, the Merge Guild process will end immediately and the merge will fail.
@{6}.If the merge fails, neither guild will be changed or otherwise affected.

column2:
Send an Invite: Rules
@{1}.Sending a merge invite means ^{1}your guild is inviting the other guild to Merge into your guild^{2}.
@{2}.After you send a merge invite, the merge process will begin once the other guild agrees and adjusts the number of members who will Merge into your guild so that it does not exceed your guild's available capacity.
@{3}.The merge will be officially completed ^{3}at 5:00 AM the following day^{4}. If the other guild has more members to merge than your guild can accept when the merge occurs, the merge will fail.
@{4}.If the merge fails, neither guild will undergo any changes or be affected in any way.

@{1}. Using a Normal Treasure Map may grant rewards (including Treasure Map Fragments), trigger an Elite Monster encounter, summon a powerful Boss, or result in a failed treasure hunt.

Stronghold Contest Phases:
The Stronghold Contest cycles through the following phases: Bidding → Preparation → In Progress → Ended.
At the end of the Season, the off-season begins. The contest will resume when the next Season starts.

Bidding:
During this phase, Guild Leaders must spend Guild Supplies to place bids and qualify for the Stronghold Contest.
For each prefecture within the same realm, only the top @{1} bidding guilds can participate in the Stronghold Contest.

Preparation:
During this phase, the bidding results and attack information are displayed so qualifying guilds can discuss their strategies.

In Progress:
The Stronghold Contest officially begins. Keep the information displayed during the Preparation phase and provide qualifying guilds with an entrance to the event.

Ended:
The results of the current Stronghold Contest are displayed. Tap Battle Record in the lower-right corner for more details on the battle's offense and defense.
When this phase ends, a new Stronghold Contest cycle begins with the Bidding phase.

column2:
1.The continent of Prontera is never short of Adventurers, and helping one another is considered its highest virtue.
2.You can add other Adventurers as friends through the game world, chat channels, rankings, and more.
3.After sending a friend request, you must wait for the other player to accept before you become friends.
4.Team up with friends to participate in activities and complete quests to earn Intimacy Points and raise your Intimacy Level.
5.Once you reach the required Intimacy Level, you will receive bonus effects when teamed up together.
6.Friends can also exchange gifts to increase their Intimacy Points.

column2:
Basic Rules:
1. MVPs share HP across multiple channels. When an MVP appears, it can be found and fought on every channel, and all battle contributions count toward the rankings.
Reward Rules:
1. MVP rewards are divided into four types: Team Rewards, Participation Rewards, First Strike Rewards, and Final Blow Rewards. Each type has an independent Reward Count and does not affect the others. Click the Reward Count for details.
2. Participation Rewards and Team Rewards have a Chance to contain Rare rewards such as cards. The higher the team's ranking, the greater the Chance of receiving them.
Ranking Rules:
1. After an MVP is defeated, scores are calculated for all participating teams based on damage dealt, damage taken, Healing Volume, and death count. Deaths deduct a small number of points. All participating teams are then ranked by score.
2. If a team has a Member who has reached the Team Reward limit, its total score will be reduced by a certain percentage. The more Members who have reached the limit, the greater the reduction.

column2:
Pet Basics
1. Unlock pets through Pet Search or by collecting enough shards.
2. Use EXP Books to Level-up pets. Respawn refunds all EXP Books used for Level-up and resets the pet to Lv. 1.
3. A pet's base stats are determined by its level and growth rate.

Pet Skills
1. Combat Skill: An active Pet Skill that can be used after the pet enters battle in modes such as Pet Tower.
2. Passive Skill: A Pet Skill that takes effect when the pet is assigned to a Utility slot.
3. Main Skill: A Pet Skill that the Adventurer can manually use in battle while the pet is assigned to the main slot.
4. Stat Activation Skill: A Pet Skill that grants the Adventurer permanent stat bonuses once the pet is unlocked, even when the pet is not deployed.

Pet Rank and Star Level
1. Every 3 pet Rank Ups increases its star level by 1.
2. Ranking up a pet increases its growth rate.
3. Increasing a pet's star level raises the star level of its Main, Passive, and Stat Activation Skills. Higher-star skills provide stronger effects.

column2:
Pet Deployment and Assist
1. The Adventurer can deploy 4 pets and assign 5 pets to Assist at the same time: 1 Main slot, 3 Utility slots, and 5 Assist slots. These slots are gradually unlocked with each Adventurer Level Increased milestone.
2. Deploying 3 pets from the same Faction activates that Faction's effect. Each Faction has a different effect.
3. Deployed pets grant the Adventurer a percentage of their base stats. The percentage differs between deployed and Assist pets.
4. A pet in the Main slot grants the Adventurer its Main Skill, while a pet in a Utility slot grants the Adventurer its Passive Skill.
5. Some pets in Utility slots provide a Core Passive with enhanced skill effects. If multiple pets with Core Passives are assigned to Utility slots, only the Core Passive in the lowest-numbered Utility slot takes effect.

column3: Ahem... well... great teachers produce great students! This craftsmanship was passed down by a true master! Just look at the workmanship, the attention to detail—it's absolutely Moonlit Challenger caliber!

column2: (Clutches chest) You drive a harder bargain than this sword's edge! That wouldn't even cover the cost!
column3: (Clutches chest) You drive a harder bargain than this sword's edge! That wouldn't even cover the cost!

column2: Ah, brave adventurer! A moment, please! I couldn't help but notice your keen eye as you surveyed the market—and the tremendous potential within you! Those are not the eyes of someone destined for mediocrity!
column3: Ah, brave adventurer! A moment, please! I couldn't help but notice your keen eye as you surveyed the market—and the tremendous potential within you! Those are not the eyes of someone destined for mediocrity!

column2: Look at these plodding masses! They're content with an ordinary steel sword and a cheap potion! But not you! I can tell by your stride that you yearn to rise above the ordinary!
column3: Look at these plodding masses! They're content with an ordinary steel sword and a cheap potion! But not you! I can tell by your stride that you yearn to rise above the ordinary!

column2: Tell me, have you ever gazed up at the stars and wondered how you could finally live up to your gifts and truly... live?
column3: Tell me, have you ever gazed up at the stars and wondered how you could finally live up to your gifts and truly... live?

column2: (Leans in slightly and lowers their voice) The Adventurers' Guild is looking for exceptional people just like you! We're not offering you a mere job, but the ultimate opportunity to rewrite your destiny and rise to the top!
column3: (Leans in slightly and lowers their voice) The Adventurers' Guild is looking for exceptional people just like you! We're not offering you a mere job, but the ultimate opportunity to rewrite your destiny and rise to the top!

column2: Don't just take my word for it—please accept this invitation. We're hosting an exclusive welcome gala at the most luxurious venue in town, the 【Oak Tavern】! There'll be endless gourmet food and fine wine, not to mention countless elite Members who've already achieved the life of their dreams!
column3: Don't just take my word for it—please accept this invitation. We're hosting an exclusive welcome gala at the most luxurious venue in town, the 【Oak Tavern】! There'll be endless gourmet food and fine wine, not to mention countless elite Members who've already achieved the life of their dreams!

column2: Give me one evening, and I'll prove that everything you've worked for has merely been preparing you to join us! What do you say? Will you give yourself a chance to reach out and touch the future?
column3: Give me one evening, and I'll prove that everything you've worked for has merely been preparing you to join us! What do you say? Will you give yourself a chance to reach out and touch the future?

column2: Now that's character! I admire your candor! But believe me, a promise from Jax carries more weight than adamantine! Come see for yourself, and you'll know I speak the truth!
column3: Now that's character! I admire your candor! But believe me, a promise from Jax carries more weight than adamantine! Come see for yourself, and you'll know I speak the truth!

column2: (Overjoyed) Wise! Incomparably wise! Come with me—our future begins with this dinner!
column3: (Overjoyed) Wise! Incomparably wise! Come with me—our future begins with this dinner!

column2: (Wiping away tears) Ever since my husband joined his guild, he hardly ever comes home. The last time I saw him was three months ago...
column3: (Wiping away tears) Ever since my husband joined his guild, he hardly ever comes home. The last time I saw him was three months ago...

column2: The last time my son came home to get some clothes, his eyes were bloodshot, and he could barely stay awake on his feet! He called it “voluntary extra training,” but I say he’s been brainwashed!
column3: The last time my son came home to get some clothes, his eyes were bloodshot, and he could barely stay awake on his feet! He called it “voluntary extra training,” but I say he’s been brainwashed!

column2: Dear families! Please understand! This is all for a happier future! They're all willingly striving for their dreams! This brief separation will lead to a joyous reunion!
column3: Dear families! Please understand! This is all for a happier future! They're all willingly striving for their dreams! This brief separation will lead to a joyous reunion!

column2: Come with me, everyone! Once you see them hard at work, you'll understand just how happy they are!
column3: Come with me, everyone! Once you see them hard at work, you'll understand just how happy they are!

column2: John, the last time you came home was three months ago. You ate, said you'd wash the dishes later, then rushed off for an “emergency assembly.” I've been waiting for you to wash them ever since.
column3: John, the last time you came home was three months ago. You ate, said you'd wash the dishes later, then rushed off for an “emergency assembly.” I've been waiting for you to wash them ever since.

column2: Ah! Now I remember! Don't worry, honey. Once we defeat the Giant Kun, we can use His Majesty's reward to buy a set of solid-gold dinnerware!
column3: Ah! Now I remember! Don't worry, honey. Once we defeat the Giant Kun, we can use His Majesty's reward to buy a set of solid-gold dinnerware!

column2: Oh? Should I learn a “turn stone into gold” spell first, so the two of us don't starve into statues before those solid-gold plates ever show up?
column3: Oh? Should I learn a “turn stone into gold” spell first, so the two of us don't starve into statues before those solid-gold plates ever show up?

column2: (Staring blankly) Last night, I dreamed I was fighting monsters... I was even more efficient than during the day... If only it were real.
column3: (Staring blankly) Last night, I dreamed I was fighting monsters... I was even more efficient than during the day... If only it were real.

column2: Come on, child. Let's go home. You need a good night's sleep.
column3: Come on, child. Let's go home. You need a good night's sleep.

column2: I thought I saw my mother. She should be in the Mjolnir Mountains. I must be dreaming again...
column3: I thought I saw my mother. She should be in the Mjolnir Mountains. I must be dreaming again...

column2: New here? I've got a 【Hardcore Grinder's Secret Elixir】 that'll keep you sharp and alert, even if it burns through your Life. It works like a charm—I use it myself! You look like a good sort, so I'll charge you just 8 tenths of the regular price!
column3: New here? I've got a 【Hardcore Grinder's Secret Elixir】 that'll keep you sharp and alert, even if it burns through your Life. It works like a charm—I use it myself! You look like a good sort, so I'll charge you just 8 tenths of the regular price!

column2: (Hands on hips) Burning through your Life? I keep you well-fed and comfortable, and you're here burning through your Life?
column3: (Hands on hips) Burning through your Life? I keep you well-fed and comfortable, and you're here burning through your Life?

column2: H-Honey, it's just a figure of speech! It's all to make money, to make money...
column3: H-Honey, it's just a figure of speech! It's all to make money, to make money...

column2: Well? Aren't our Members fired up? Now make your choice! Will you join us and build the future together? Or... settle for mediocrity among those who cannot comprehend our lofty ideals?
column3: Well? Aren't our Members fired up? Now make your choice! Will you join us and build the future together? Or... settle for mediocrity among those who cannot comprehend our lofty ideals?

column2: Heh, to each their own. What a shame. Please accept this small gift as a Thank You for your help earlier. May life always be so... “easy” for you.
column3: Heh, to each their own. What a shame. Please accept this small gift as a Thank You for your help earlier. May life always be so... “easy” for you.

column2: Excellent—a wise choice! Welcome to the Fighters' Guild. Here's your signing bonus!
column3: Excellent—a wise choice! Welcome to the Fighters' Guild. Here's your signing bonus!

column2: Hello! What can I get for you?
column3: Hello! What can I get for you?

column2: All set—I've packed it up for you. Thanks for your business!
column3: All set—I've packed it up for you. Thanks for your business!

column2: Ah, a sandwich! Thank you so much! I can't get delivery out here, and I'm practically starving.
column3: Ah, a sandwich! Thank you so much! I can't get delivery out here, and I'm practically starving.

column2: I called you all the way out here to show you this! My masterpiece—the 【Pseudogyne Pheromone】! One spritz, and the Giant Ants will treat you like their queen!
column3: I called you all the way out here to show you this! My masterpiece—the 【Pseudogyne Pheromone】! One spritz, and the Giant Ants will treat you like their queen!

column2: Well, well. Looks like someone's already forgotten the time the ants carried you off like a takeout order??
column3: Well, well. Looks like someone's already forgotten the time the ants carried you off like a takeout order??

column2: C-Captain! That was valuable field data, and this time, I have a flawless product of science. Emotions lead to mistakes, but science never does.
column3: C-Captain! That was valuable field data, and this time, I have a flawless product of science. Emotions lead to mistakes, but science never does.

column2: All right, great scientist. Should I send a team of Adventurers with you so you don't get carried off again?
column3: All right, great scientist. Should I send a team of Adventurers with you so you don't get carried off again?

column2: N-No need to trouble yourself. This reliable warrior here is all I need to assist with the test...
column3: N-No need to trouble yourself. This reliable warrior here is all I need to assist with the test...

column2: Fine. You two stay safe. But Professor, if anything goes wrong again, the Order may have to... temporarily take charge of your personal freedom.
column3: Fine. You two stay safe. But Professor, if anything goes wrong again, the Order may have to... temporarily take charge of your personal freedom.

column2: It a-absolutely won't! I'm confident there won't be any problems this time.
column3: It a-absolutely won't! I'm confident there won't be any problems this time.

column2: That's good. Hey, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm leaving this remarkable Professor in your care. Don't let him get too carried away.
column3: That's good. Hey, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm leaving this remarkable Professor in your care. Don't let him get too carried away.

column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, here—take my precious [Pseudo-Queen Pheromone]. Don't drop it! Just sprinkle it on You.
column3: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, here—take my precious [Pseudo-Queen Pheromone]. Don't drop it! Just sprinkle it on You.

column2: It's a resounding success! It's so docile around you—far beyond my expectations. This proves the bond created by the pheromone is stable and emotionally grounded. I imagine riding it will go smoothly too...
column3: It's a resounding success! It's so docile around you—far beyond my expectations. This proves the bond created by the pheromone is stable and emotionally grounded. I imagine riding it will go smoothly too...

column2: Captain Aikuni, do you see this? Such a gentle temperament! Such a powerful physique! This will be a revolutionary innovation! Giant ants could become stronger, more Excellent mounts than Peco Pecos. And according to my research, their adaptability to difficult terrain is also Excellent.
column3: Captain Aikuni, do you see this? Such a gentle temperament! Such a powerful physique! This will be a revolutionary innovation! Giant ants could become stronger, more Excellent mounts than Peco Pecos. And according to my research, their adaptability to difficult terrain is also Excellent.

column2: Professor, the most important quality in a proper mount is reliability. My Peco Peco won't suddenly throw its rider off or... ahem, develop any unnecessary [Romantic Feelings]. Safety first, right?
column3: Professor, the most important quality in a proper mount is reliability. My Peco Peco won't suddenly throw its rider off or... ahem, develop any unnecessary [Romantic Feelings]. Safety first, right?

column2: ...That's prejudice! A conservative attitude toward unknown technology! My giant ant's pheromones have been calibrated, and its stability has been calculated. Your Peco Peco is the one that's... a featherbrain!
column3: ...That's prejudice! A conservative attitude toward unknown technology! My giant ant's pheromones have been calibrated, and its stability has been calculated. Your Peco Peco is the one that's... a featherbrain!

column2: Oh? A featherbrain, maybe, but at least it won't turn your research into another rescue mission. So you think your "calculations" can beat the reliability Peco Pecos have proven over thousands of years?
column3: Oh? A featherbrain, maybe, but at least it won't turn your research into another rescue mission. So you think your "calculations" can beat the reliability Peco Pecos have proven over thousands of years?

column2: O-Of course! Science is about constantly challenging and surpassing tradition.
column3: O-Of course! Science is about constantly challenging and surpassing tradition.

column2: Talk is cheap. As it happens, I know an abandoned Peco Peco racetrack. How about a race between your giant ant and my Peco Peco? Let the results speak for themselves. Unless... you're afraid?
column3: Talk is cheap. As it happens, I know an abandoned Peco Peco racetrack. How about a race between your giant ant and my Peco Peco? Let the results speak for themselves. Unless... you're afraid?

column2: You're on! My research will never lose to some bird! PlayerName, let's head to the racetrack.
column3: You're on! My research will never lose to some bird! PlayerName, let's head to the racetrack.

column2: Hahaha! All right. Let me know when you're ready.
column3: Hahaha! All right. Let me know when you're ready.

column2: Well? Ready to face my Peco Peco?
column3: Well? Ready to face my Peco Peco?

column2: Sigh... The specimen is gone, and I didn't even finish recording the valuable field data. But! This incident proves there's one crucial area where my theory can be improved—
column3: Sigh... The specimen is gone, and I didn't even finish recording the valuable field data. But! This incident proves there's one crucial area where my theory can be improved—

column2: Pheromone stability is positively correlated with the host's physiological state. The adrenaline or some other metabolic byproduct produced during the race must have interfered with normal pheromone receptor binding. This wasn't a failure—it eliminated one major false lead!
column3: Pheromone stability is positively correlated with the host's physiological state. The adrenaline or some other metabolic byproduct produced during the race must have interfered with normal pheromone receptor binding. This wasn't a failure—it eliminated one major false lead!

column2: Professor, are you saying you plan to continue your research? That thing nearly ate all three of us!
column3: Professor, are you saying you plan to continue your research? That thing nearly ate all three of us!

column2: Every great innovation comes with risks. Juno's first airship didn't get far on its maiden flight either. I need to adjust the formula's concentration and application method—not abandon the entire field of research.
column3: Every great innovation comes with risks. Juno's first airship didn't get far on its maiden flight either. I need to adjust the formula's concentration and application method—not abandon the entire field of research.

column2: All right, I get it. Stopping you from doing research is harder than making an ant obey. But Professor, we're setting some ground rules. Before your next experiment, you must submit an "Extremely Detailed Safety Plan" to me.
column3: All right, I get it. Stopping you from doing research is harder than making an ant obey. But Professor, we're setting some ground rules. Before your next experiment, you must submit an "Extremely Detailed Safety Plan" to me.

column2: The caravan was attacked again? By Baphomet? Peace has been hard to come by in that area lately. Professor, did you have more important equipment shipped here?
column3: The caravan was attacked again? By Baphomet? Peace has been hard to come by in that area lately. Professor, did you have more important equipment shipped here?

column2: Wh-What?! W-Where did you say? The Black Forest?! Baphomet?! No, no, no! This is a disaster!
column3: Wh-What?! W-Where did you say? The Black Forest?! Baphomet?! No, no, no! This is a disaster!

column2: Is it that important? If necessary, we can find a way to get you another one. I have some connections in Juno—
column3: Is it that important? If necessary, we can find a way to get you another one. I have some connections in Juno—

column2: It's not equipment! It's alive! There's something alive in that crate!
column3: It's not equipment! It's alive! There's something alive in that crate!

column2: Professor, be clear. What do you mean by "alive"? What kind of creature did you ship? Don't tell me you've violated the kingdom's safety regulations again!
column3: Professor, be clear. What do you mean by "alive"? What kind of creature did you ship? Don't tell me you've violated the kingdom's safety regulations again!

column2: It's [Little Bean]! An old classmate of mine in Juno could no longer care for the kitten, so they entrusted [Little Bean] to me. I-If Glenn finds out I lost Little Bean, he'll never speak to me again...
column3: It's [Little Bean]! An old classmate of mine in Juno could no longer care for the kitten, so they entrusted [Little Bean] to me. I-If Glenn finds out I lost Little Bean, he'll never speak to me again...

column2: So it's a pet cat. Professor, what were you thinking? Why didn't you transport it by airship?
column3: So it's a pet cat. Professor, what were you thinking? Why didn't you transport it by airship?

column2: I heard animals sometimes suffocate in airship cargo holds, so I specifically hired a company that transports animals overland... What do I do? What am I going to do?!
column3: I heard animals sometimes suffocate in airship cargo holds, so I specifically hired a company that transports animals overland... What do I do? What am I going to do?!

column2: Enough! This is no time to panic. We need to head to the scene immediately and find that cat before Baphomet—or anything else—can hurt it.
column3: Enough! This is no time to panic. We need to head to the scene immediately and find that cat before Baphomet—or anything else—can hurt it.

column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, the situation has changed. This is no longer a simple search for cargo. We have to act. Let's leave immediately.
column3: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, the situation has changed. This is no longer a simple search for cargo. We have to act. Let's leave immediately.

column2: Hello! Are you the reliable Adventurer Captain Aikuni mentioned? It's a pleasure to meet you. You're here about the bounty notice, correct?
column3: Hello! Are you the reliable Adventurer Captain Aikuni mentioned? It's a pleasure to meet you. You're here about the bounty notice, correct?

column2: To be honest, this case has us stumped. There have been three thefts in the city recently, but the victims and stolen items are completely different. We can barely find anything they have in common.
column3: To be honest, this case has us stumped. There have been three thefts in the city recently, but the victims and stolen items are completely different. We can barely find anything they have in common.

column2: The first victim was Blacksmith Hollgrehenn. He lost a fine sword. The second was Nita, a young woman who lives on the west side of the city. She lost a piece of jewelry. The third was a Mage from Geffen who reportedly had a very important spellbook stolen.
column3: The first victim was Blacksmith Hollgrehenn. He lost a fine sword. The second was Nita, a young woman who lives on the west side of the city. She lost a piece of jewelry. The third was a Mage from Geffen who reportedly had a very important spellbook stolen.

column2: We didn't uncover much in the way of a Clue during our interviews... You should visit them yourself. You may Discover some detail in their accounts that we overlooked.
column3: We didn't uncover much in the way of a Clue during our interviews... You should visit them yourself. You may Discover some detail in their accounts that we overlooked.

column2: Hey! A new face! Are you an Adventurer looking to refine your gear? Then Hollgrehenn's your man! Bring me good materials, and I'll hammer your gear as high as you dare!
column3: Hey! A new face! Are you an Adventurer looking to refine your gear? Then Hollgrehenn's your man! Bring me good materials, and I'll hammer your gear as high as you dare!

column2: Oh, that. Yeah, I lost a fine weapon. A longtime customer left it with me to Enchant. Sigh... I really let them down after they placed their trust in me.
column3: Oh, that. Yeah, I lost a fine weapon. A longtime customer left it with me to Enchant. Sigh... I really let them down after they placed their trust in me.

column2: Honestly, I don't remember how it vanished. The shop was packed that day, and I was running all over the place. I left the weapon on that rack, turned away for a moment, and it was gone. Who did it? What did they look like? I don't remember a thing.
column3: Honestly, I don't remember how it vanished. The shop was packed that day, and I was running all over the place. I left the weapon on that rack, turned away for a moment, and it was gone. Who did it? What did they look like? I don't remember a thing.

column2: Something unusual? Now that you mention it... Heh, there was one thing. Just before closing, a particularly... uh... passionate lady came into the shop. And the way she was dressed... Whew! She was like a blazing flame!
column3: Something unusual? Now that you mention it... Heh, there was one thing. Just before closing, a particularly... uh... passionate lady came into the shop. And the way she was dressed... Whew! She was like a blazing flame!

column2: She didn't really do anything. She just watched me smithing for quite a while. Then she came over, leaned in real close, and said I looked so strong and manly while working the forge...
column3: She didn't really do anything. She just watched me smithing for quite a while. Then she came over, leaned in real close, and said I looked so strong and manly while working the forge...

column2: I'd never heard anything like that before! My heart was pounding, and my head got all fuzzy. She complimented me a few times, then left with a smile without buying anything. It still makes me happy just thinking about it! Haha!
column3: I'd never heard anything like that before! My heart was pounding, and my head got all fuzzy. She complimented me a few times, then left with a smile without buying anything. It still makes me happy just thinking about it! Haha!

column2: But happy as it made me, the weapon is still missing. Sigh... I wish I could be more help. You don't think that beautiful lady took it, do you? She didn't look like a bad person.
column3: But happy as it made me, the weapon is still missing. Sigh... I wish I could be more help. You don't think that beautiful lady took it, do you? She didn't look like a bad person.

column2: Welcome! Would you like a bouquet for someone special? The birds of paradise look especially vibrant today!
column3: Welcome! Would you like a bouquet for someone special? The birds of paradise look especially vibrant today!

column2: Oh, you mean my gold ring... It was the most precious thing my mother left me. I always took such good care of it. I truly don't understand how it could have disappeared.
column3: Oh, you mean my gold ring... It was the most precious thing my mother left me. I always took such good care of it. I truly don't understand how it could have disappeared.

column2: That day... I was tending the flowers and helping customers, just like always. I kept the ring on my finger, but I never noticed when it disappeared. It was as if it just... vanished without me realizing.
column3: That day... I was tending the flowers and helping customers, just like always. I kept the ring on my finger, but I never noticed when it disappeared. It was as if it just... vanished without me realizing.

column2: Something unusual? Now that you ask... Yes, there was! I think I had... a fateful encounter!
column3: Something unusual? Now that you ask... Yes, there was! I think I had... a fateful encounter!

column2: That evening, just as I was about to close the shop, a gentleman passed by. His clothes were a little worn, and he looked exhausted, but... he was so handsome! He had this melancholy air, like a noble knight fallen on hard times in a story!
column3: That evening, just as I was about to close the shop, a gentleman passed by. His clothes were a little worn, and he looked exhausted, but... he was so handsome! He had this melancholy air, like a noble knight fallen on hard times in a story!

column2: He shyly asked if I had anything to eat because he was so hungry he could barely walk. Oh my, can you imagine? It was exactly like something out of a novel!
column3: He shyly asked if I had anything to eat because he was so hungry he could barely walk. Oh my, can you imagine? It was exactly like something out of a novel!

column2: What do I do after that?
column3: What do I do after that?

column2: I happened to have a ham sandwich for my dinner, so I gave it to him. He ate it so elegantly, then gave me a solemn Thank You and said my kindness had brightened his dreary day. Just thinking about it makes me so happy!
column3: I happened to have a ham sandwich for my dinner, so I gave it to him. He ate it so elegantly, then gave me a solemn Thank You and said my kindness had brightened his dreary day. Just thinking about it makes me so happy!

column2: But... my ring disappeared after that. Maybe I dropped it somewhere by accident? That prince-like gentleman couldn't possibly have taken it, could he? No, of course not!
column3: But... my ring disappeared after that. Maybe I dropped it somewhere by accident? That prince-like gentleman couldn't possibly have taken it, could he? No, of course not!

column2: ...It makes no sense! Absolutely none! The protective barrier wasn't triggered, and the seal on the chest is completely intact. How could the book simply vanish? This violates the third, fifth, and seventh of the Twelve Fundamental Laws of Protective Magic!
column3: ...It makes no sense! Absolutely none! The protective barrier wasn't triggered, and the seal on the chest is completely intact. How could the book simply vanish? This violates the third, fifth, and seventh of the Twelve Fundamental Laws of Protective Magic!

column2: Are you the investigator? Thank goodness! Please, you must help me recover the missing book. It's no ordinary spellbook—the knowledge it contains is extremely dangerous. If misused, the consequences could be catastrophic! I must take it back to Geffen Tower and seal it away.
column3: Are you the investigator? Thank goodness! Please, you must help me recover the missing book. It's no ordinary spellbook—the knowledge it contains is extremely dangerous. If misused, the consequences could be catastrophic! I must take it back to Geffen Tower and seal it away.

column2: How did the book go missing?
column3: How did the book go missing?

column2: I... I don't know. I checked countless times. It was in my lockbox, and I even confirmed it was there after arriving in Prontera. But before I was ready to leave for Geffen, it vanished. There were no signs of forced entry whatsoever.
column3: I... I don't know. I checked countless times. It was in my lockbox, and I even confirmed it was there after arriving in Prontera. But before I was ready to leave for Geffen, it vanished. There were no signs of forced entry whatsoever.

column2: Anything unusual? Everything went according to protocol. If I had to name something that disrupted my carefully planned itinerary... Hmm... there was one insignificant little incident.
column3: Anything unusual? Everything went according to protocol. If I had to name something that disrupted my carefully planned itinerary... Hmm... there was one insignificant little incident.

column2: On my way to the Guild, I spotted a creature in an alley. It was a... uh... Siamese cat. Strictly speaking, these cats are only found in the faraway East. They're extremely rare! Its figure was quite... Ahem! Anyway, it was sunning itself and looked very docile.
column3: On my way to the Guild, I spotted a creature in an alley. It was a... uh... Siamese cat. Strictly speaking, these cats are only found in the faraway East. They're extremely rare! Its figure was quite... Ahem! Anyway, it was sunning itself and looked very docile.

column2: I... I looked around and made sure I wasn't violating the Geffen Code of Public Conduct... Then, out of basic concern for a living creature, I crouched down... and patted it on the head.
column3: I... I looked around and made sure I wasn't violating the Geffen Code of Public Conduct... Then, out of basic concern for a living creature, I crouched down... and patted it on the head.

column2: Its purring... According to current research, it has a soothing effect on the nerves... But that has absolutely nothing to do with the theft! It was merely a brief, perfectly reasonable Interaction.
column3: Its purring... According to current research, it has a soothing effect on the nerves... But that has absolutely nothing to do with the theft! It was merely a brief, perfectly reasonable Interaction.

column2: Right, there couldn't possibly be a connection! Are you accusing an innocent little kitten purring in the sun of being a thief? Absurd! This must be the work of some sophisticated spatial magic yet unknown to us!
column3: Right, there couldn't possibly be a connection! Are you accusing an innocent little kitten purring in the sun of being a thief? Absurd! This must be the work of some sophisticated spatial magic yet unknown to us!

column2: Help... Help me... Water... Just one sip... The desert... shows no mercy to the careless...
column3: Help... Help me... Water... Just one sip... The desert... shows no mercy to the careless...

column2: Hey, my friend! You're back! Judging by the look on your face, do you have good news for me?
column3: Hey, my friend! You're back! Judging by the look on your face, do you have good news for me?

column2: Wonderful, that's really it! Thank You so much—you've done both me and one of my longtime customers a huge favor!
column3: Wonderful, that's really it! Thank You so much—you've done both me and one of my longtime customers a huge favor!

column2: Come on, tell me—who was it? How did they pull off something so skillful? I still can't figure out how they did it.
column3: Come on, tell me—who was it? How did they pull off something so skillful? I still can't figure out how they did it.

column2: Wh... what? It was... her? But how...? She sounded so sincere when she praised my smithing... Could it be... was all that just so she could steal from me? Ugh, this hurts worse than failing a +@{1} refinement...

column2:
In the waters surrounding the continent of Midgard lies a little-known island. It appears on no sea chart, and only ships that have lost their way occasionally stumble upon it. Yet no crew dares linger there, for terrifying, thunderous roars have echoed from the island's depths for as long as anyone can remember.
 
Legend holds that the dragon Fafnir is sealed deep within the island. Once a descendant of the giants, he was slain by a descendant of Odin for his insatiable greed for treasure. After Ragnarök, he returned from the underworld to Midgard, transformed into a decaying dragon driven by nothing but greed. To stop Fafnir's plunder and slaughter, people built fortresses, Turrets, and magic formations across the nameless island. Using gold as bait, they ultimately sealed him away through tremendous Devotion. Thus, the island came to be known as Dragon Sarcophagus Isle.

Centuries have since passed, and the seal's power has begun to wane. The roars from the island grow more deafening by the day, while monsters drawn by the dragon's call gather nearby and relentlessly attack the seal.

Fafnir, the dragon once thought safely sealed away, has lost none of his greed. His power stirs deep within Dragon Sarcophagus Isle, threatening the Peace of the continent.

Faced with this threat, the Guild has issued a call to arms. To protect the continent of Midgard and prevent Fafnir from unleashing another catastrophe, brave Adventurers must be assembled. These heroes will form a dragon-slaying force, travel to Dragon Sarcophagus Isle, and challenge Fafnir once more for the sake of the continent's future.
To restore the seal, keep the greedy dragon contained, and protect the Peace of the continent of Midgard, the Guild must gather the bravest Adventurers into a dragon-slaying force and send them to Dragon Sarcophagus Isle to challenge the dragon once more.

column3: ผลไม้สีเหลืองรูปทรงรี ใช้ปรุงรสอาหารและเพิ่มกลิ่นหอม\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: White granulated crystals used to sweeten dishes.
column3: ผลึกเม็ดสีขาวสำหรับเพิ่มความหวานให้อาหาร

column2: Tender animal meat that can be grilled or stewed for a variety of meat dishes.
column3: เนื้อสัตว์นุ่มที่นำไปย่างหรือตุ๋นเป็นอาหารประเภทเนื้อได้หลากหลาย

column2: An umbrella-shaped mushroom with thick, savory flesh, often used in stews and stir-fries.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: เห็ดรูปทรงร่ม เนื้อหนาและรสกลมกล่อม มักใช้ทำสตูว์และผัด\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: A juicy, bright Red fruit with a sweet-and-sour flavor, perfect for stews or soup bases.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: ผลไม้สีแดงสดฉ่ำ รสหวานอมเปรี้ยว เหมาะสำหรับสตูว์หรือน้ำซุป\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: Dark brown beans that can be ground into Cacao powder for making desserts.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: เมล็ดสีน้ำตาลเข้มที่สามารถบดเป็นผงคาเคาเพื่อทำของหวาน\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: A round Purple fruit that can be made into fine wine or desserts.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: ผลไม้สีม่วงทรงกลม สามารถทำเป็นไวน์หรือของหวานชั้นดี\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: Bright Red and spicy, it adds heat and aroma to Cooking.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: สีแดงสดและเผ็ดร้อน เพิ่มความเผ็ดและกลิ่นหอมให้อาหาร\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: Golden Grains that can be ground into flour for noodles, pastries, and other dishes.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: ธัญพืชสีทองที่สามารถบดเป็นแป้งเพื่อทำเส้น ขนมอบ และอาหารอื่นๆ\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: Tender Green leaves from a Basic herb that adds aroma and flavor to Cooking.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: ใบเขียวอ่อนของสมุนไพรพื้นฐาน ช่วยเพิ่มกลิ่นหอมและรสชาติให้อาหาร\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: White Herb: Its pure White leaves add a subtle herbal aroma to Cooking.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: White Herb: ใบสีขาวบริสุทธิ์เพิ่มกลิ่นสมุนไพรอ่อนๆ ให้อาหาร\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: Yellow Herb: Golden in color, it enhances the aroma and flavor of Cooking.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: Yellow Herb: สีทองอร่าม เพิ่มกลิ่นหอมและรสชาติให้อาหาร\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: A bright Red Herb that adds a unique flavor and medicinal properties to Cooking.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Gardener^{2}. Used by the Life Skill - Chef for Cooking.
column3: Red Herb สีแดงสด เพิ่มรสชาติเฉพาะตัวและสรรพคุณทางยาให้อาหาร\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Gardener^{2} ใช้ทำอาหารด้วยทักษะชีวิต - Chef

column2: Legendary sharpening Material imbued with the power of a meteorite. It grants Weapons devastating power.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: วัสดุลับคมระดับตำนานที่อัดพลังอุกกาบาต มอบพลังทำลายล้างแก่อาวุธ\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: Premium sharpening Material infused with the essence of luminous gold. It gives Weapons astonishing sharpness.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: วัสดุลับคมระดับพรีเมียมที่อัดแก่นพลังทองเรืองแสง ทำให้อาวุธคมอย่างน่าอัศจรรย์\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: A whetstone polished multiple times to greatly improve a weapon's cutting power and durability.
column3: หินลับมีดที่ผ่านการขัดหลายครั้ง ช่วยเพิ่มความคมและความทนทานของอาวุธอย่างมาก

column2: A whetstone made using a special process. It improves a Weapon's sharpness.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: หินลับมีดที่ผลิตด้วยกระบวนการพิเศษ ช่วยเพิ่มความคมของอาวุธ\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: A hilt forged from Meteor Metal and imbued with the power of a falling star. It greatly improves weapon performance and handling.
column3: ด้ามอาวุธที่ตีขึ้นจาก Meteor Metal และอัดพลังดาวตก ช่วยเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพและความคล่องตัวในการใช้อาวุธอย่างมาก

column2: A dense Meteor Metal block compressed using a special process. Its energy purity and strength have reached their peak, making it ideal for crafting advanced weapons.
column3: ก้อน Meteor Metal เนื้อแน่นที่อัดด้วยกระบวนการพิเศษ มีความบริสุทธิ์ของพลังงานและความแข็งแรงสูงสุด เหมาะสำหรับสร้างอาวุธระดับสูง

column2: A sharp blade forged from Meteor Metal. Its potential to pierce anything makes it a vital component of advanced weapons.
column3: คมดาบที่ตีขึ้นจาก Meteor Metal ด้วยศักยภาพที่จะเจาะทะลุทุกสิ่ง จึงเป็นชิ้นส่วนสำคัญของอาวุธระดับสูง

column2: A Metal block taken from the core of a meteorite. Its exceptional purity and energy make it a precious material for crafting advanced equipment.
column3: ก้อนโลหะจากแกนอุกกาบาต ความบริสุทธิ์และพลังงานอันยอดเยี่ยมทำให้เป็นวัสดุล้ำค่าสำหรับสร้างอุปกรณ์ระดับสูง

column2: A high-grade grinding wheel made with precision techniques, capable of ultra-fine polishing when crafting advanced weapons.
column3: หินเจียรระดับสูงที่ผลิตด้วยเทคนิคแม่นยำ สามารถขัดละเอียดเป็นพิเศษในการสร้างอาวุธระดับสูง

column2: A hilt forged from a dense Radiant Gold block. Its smooth, sturdy finish makes it ideal for crafting fine weapons.
column3: ด้ามอาวุธที่ตีขึ้นจากก้อน Radiant Gold เนื้อแน่น ผิวเรียบและแข็งแรง เหมาะสำหรับสร้างอาวุธคุณภาพดี

column2: A Radiant Gold block refined under extreme heat and pressure for optimal Metal purity and strength, ideal for crafting fine weapon parts.
column3: ก้อน Radiant Gold ที่ผ่านความร้อนและแรงดันสูงมากเพื่อให้โลหะมีความบริสุทธิ์และความแข็งแรงเหมาะสมที่สุด เหมาะสำหรับสร้างชิ้นส่วนอาวุธคุณภาพดี

column2: A blade forged from radiant gold with exceptional sharpness and durability. Suitable for crafting fine weapons.
column3: คมดาบที่ตีขึ้นจากทองอันสุกสว่าง มีความคมและความทนทานเป็นเลิศ เหมาะสำหรับสร้างอาวุธชั้นดี

column2: A Metal bar smelted from radiant gold. Lightweight yet hard, it is a core material for crafting fine equipment.
column3: แท่งโลหะที่หลอมจากทองอันสุกสว่าง น้ำหนักเบาแต่แข็ง เป็นวัตถุดิบหลักสำหรับสร้างอุปกรณ์ชั้นดี

column2: A grip forged from mithril that improves a weapon's handling and durability. Suitable for crafting standard weapons.
column3: ด้ามจับที่ตีขึ้นจากมิธริล ช่วยเพิ่มความคล่องตัวในการใช้และความทนทานของอาวุธ เหมาะสำหรับสร้างอาวุธมาตรฐาน

column2: Made from rough stone, it grinds efficiently but provides only an average polish. Suitable for sharpening standard weapons.
column3: ทำจากหินหยาบ เจียรได้มีประสิทธิภาพแต่ขัดผิวได้เพียงระดับปานกลาง เหมาะสำหรับลับอาวุธมาตรฐาน

column2: A Metal bar smelted from mithril. Both tough and lightweight, it can be used to forge standard equipment.
column3: แท่งโลหะที่หลอมจาก mithril ทั้งแข็งแกร่งและน้ำหนักเบา ใช้ตีอุปกรณ์มาตรฐานได้

column2: Soaking iron several times in a special solution increases its strength, producing harder weapons and armor.
column3: การแช่เหล็กในสารละลายพิเศษหลายครั้งช่วยเพิ่มความแข็งแรง ทำให้อาวุธและเกราะแข็งขึ้น

column2: High-quality compressed coal that burns at extremely high temperatures. Combining it with iron produces stronger steel.
column3: ถ่านหินอัดคุณภาพสูงที่เผาไหม้ด้วยอุณหภูมิสูงมาก เมื่อนำไปรวมกับเหล็กจะได้เหล็กกล้าที่แข็งแรงขึ้น

column2: Not only is it sufficiently hard, but it is also easier to work with than other Metals.
column3: มีความแข็งเพียงพอและขึ้นรูปได้ง่ายกว่าโลหะอื่น

column2: Ore containing meteorite that can be refined into a Meteorite Chunk.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: แร่ที่มีอุกกาบาต สามารถถลุงเป็น Meteorite Chunk\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: A precious gemstone that gleams like a cat's eye and radiates a beautiful light.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: อัญมณีล้ำค่าที่เปล่งประกายดุจดวงตาแมวและส่องแสงงดงาม\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: An extremely sturdy stone with exceptional hardness, used to make Weapons.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: หินที่แข็งแกร่งมากและมีความแข็งเป็นพิเศษ ใช้ทำอาวุธ\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: Ore containing luminous gold that can be refined into a Luminous Gold Ingot.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: แร่ที่มีทองเรืองแสง สามารถถลุงเป็น Luminous Gold Ingot\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: Ore containing mithril that can be refined into a Mithril Ingot.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: แร่ที่มีมิธริล สามารถถลุงเป็น Mithril Ingot\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: As night falls, the stars resemble carefully Collected gemstones. Awed by their light rippling like water, people named this stone Sobbing Starlight.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: ยามค่ำคืน ดวงดาวดูราวกับอัญมณีที่เก็บรวบรวมไว้อย่างประณีต ผู้คนตะลึงกับแสงที่พลิ้วไหวดั่งสายน้ำ จึงตั้งชื่อหินนี้ว่า Sobbing Starlight\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: A Normal stone found almost anywhere. It may look unremarkable, but it still has its uses.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: หินธรรมดาที่พบได้แทบทุกแห่ง แม้ดูไม่โดดเด่น แต่ก็ยังมีประโยชน์\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: Ore rich in carbon. The coal extracted from it can be refined with iron to produce Steel.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: แร่ที่อุดมด้วยคาร์บอน ถ่านหินที่สกัดได้สามารถถลุงร่วมกับเหล็กเพื่อผลิต Steel\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: Ore containing iron that can be refined into an Iron Ingot.\nObtainable through ^{1}Life Skill - Miner^{2}. Used to Craft T@{1} Equipment.
column3: แร่ที่มีเหล็ก สามารถถลุงเป็น Iron Ingot\nได้รับจาก ^{1}ทักษะชีวิต - Miner^{2} ใช้สร้างอุปกรณ์ T@{1}

column2: Restores @{1} Life Skill Vigor upon use.
column3: ใช้เพื่อฟื้นฟู Vigor ของ Life Skill @{1} แต้ม

column2: An official certificate issued by the workshop, signifying that the holder has passed the Job Advance assessment and is qualified to independently pursue a Life Skill.
column3: ใบรับรองอย่างเป็นทางการจากโรงงาน แสดงว่าผู้ถือผ่านการประเมินเลื่อนอาชีพและมีคุณสมบัติประกอบทักษะชีวิตด้วยตนเอง

column2: Item used to Learn a skill.
column3: ไอเทมสำหรับเรียนรู้สกิล

column2: Item used to Level-up a title.
column3: ไอเทมสำหรับเพิ่มเลเวลฉายา

column2: Hide from a blue Pegasus said to exist only in Legend!\nIt's warm and soft to the touch.
column3: หนังจาก Pegasus สีน้ำเงินที่ว่ากันว่ามีอยู่เพียงในตำนาน!\nสัมผัสอบอุ่นและนุ่มนวล

column2: A hard shell from a monster. Available from the Collector.
column3: เปลือกแข็งจากมอนสเตอร์ หาได้จาก Collector

column2: A shell from a turtle's back. Once dried, it becomes extremely hard and can be processed into many useful items. Available from the Collector.
column3: กระดองจากหลังเต่า เมื่อทำให้แห้งจะแข็งมาก สามารถแปรรูปเป็นไอเทมที่มีประโยชน์ได้หลายชนิด หาซื้อได้จาก Collector

column2: A geometrically shaped fragment of Sobbing Starlight. It might be restored if the pieces are carefully reassembled.
column3: เศษ Sobbing Starlight รูปทรงเรขาคณิต อาจฟื้นสภาพได้หากประกอบชิ้นส่วนกลับอย่างระมัดระวัง

column2: A fragment of a star cluster suspended in the sky. It can increase a weapon's strength when used in crafting.
column3: เศษกระจุกดาวที่ลอยอยู่บนฟ้า ใช้สร้างอาวุธเพื่อเพิ่มความแข็งแรงได้

column2: A knife-sharp scale that can be processed into many useful items. Available from the Collector.
column3: เกล็ดคมราวใบมีด แปรรูปเป็นไอเทมที่มีประโยชน์ได้หลายชนิด หาได้จาก Collector

column2: A fingernail taken from the dead. Available from the Collector.
column3: เล็บจากผู้ตาย หาได้จาก Collector

column2: A piece of a star that can be refined into Star Crumbs.
column3: ชิ้นส่วนดาวที่สามารถแปรรูปเป็น Star Crumbs

column2: A canine tooth obtained from a creature called an Orc. Available from the Collector.
column3: เขี้ยวที่ได้จากสิ่งมีชีวิตชื่อ Orc หาซื้อได้จาก Collector

column2: A toenail clipped from a wolf's paw. Available from the Collector.
column3: เล็บที่ตัดจากอุ้งเท้าหมาป่า หาซื้อได้จาก Collector

column2: Rare mane taken from a monster. Tough and magical, it can be used to make high-grade fabric or in alchemical formulas.
column3: แผงคอหายากจากมอนสเตอร์ เหนียวและมีเวทมนตร์ ใช้ทำผ้าระดับสูงหรือเป็นส่วนผสมในการเล่นแร่แปรธาตุได้

column2:
The late Emperor had yet to complete half of his great undertaking when he passed away. Now the realm is divided into three, and Yizhou is exhausted and weakened. This is truly a critical moment upon which our survival depends. Yet the officials of the imperial guard remain diligent at court, while loyal and devoted officers abroad risk their lives, all because they remember the late Emperor's exceptional kindness and wish to repay it to Your Majesty. You should open your ears to wise counsel, thereby honoring the late Emperor's legacy and inspiring those of lofty ideals. You should not belittle yourself or make improper comparisons that would block the path of loyal remonstrance.

　　The imperial palace and the government offices are one body; rewards and punishments, praise and censure, should be administered by the same standards. If anyone commits treachery or violates the law, or performs loyal and virtuous deeds, the proper authorities should determine their punishment or reward, thereby demonstrating Your Majesty's just and impartial rule. You should show no favoritism or allow different laws to apply within and outside the palace.

　　Palace Attendants and Vice Directors Guo Youzhi, Fei Yi, Dong Yun, and the others are all honest and capable men, loyal and pure in purpose and judgment. For this reason, the late Emperor selected and promoted them to serve Your Majesty. In my humble opinion, all palace affairs, great or small, should be discussed with them before being carried out. They will surely remedy omissions and shortcomings and bring broad benefit.

　　General Xiang Chong is virtuous and fair in character and conduct, and thoroughly versed in military affairs. When his abilities were tested in the past, the late Emperor praised him as capable. The officers therefore unanimously recommended Chong as commander. In my humble opinion, all military affairs should be discussed with him. He will surely bring harmony to the ranks and assign every soldier according to his ability.

　　Drawing close to worthy ministers and keeping petty men Away was how the Former Han flourished; drawing close to petty men and keeping worthy ministers Away was how the Later Han declined. Whenever the late Emperor discussed this matter with me, he never failed to lament the reigns of Emperors Huan and Ling with bitter regret. The Palace Attendants, Directors of the Secretariat, Chief Clerks, and Army Advisers are all faithful and upright ministers willing to die for their principles. I pray that Your Majesty will remain close to them and place your trust in them. Then the restoration of the House of Han may soon be expected.

　　I was once a commoner, personally tilling the fields in Nanyang. I sought only to preserve my life in troubled times and had no desire for fame or distinction among the feudal lords. The late Emperor did not disdain me for my humble station or lowly origins, but graciously humbled himself to visit me three times at my thatched cottage and consult me about the affairs of the age. Moved by his kindness, I pledged myself to his service. Later, when disaster struck, I accepted responsibility amid defeat and received my orders in a time of peril. Twenty-one years have passed since then.

　　The late Emperor knew that I was cautious, and so, as death approached, he entrusted me with this great responsibility. Since receiving his command, I have worried and sighed day and night, fearing that I might fail in my charge and thereby tarnish the late Emperor's wisdom. Thus, in the fifth month, I crossed the Lu River and ventured deep into barren lands. Now the south has been pacified and our arms and provisions are sufficient. We should rally the three armies, march north to secure the Central Plains, and devote what little ability I possess to eliminating the traitors and villains, restoring the House of Han, and returning to the old capital. This is my duty in repaying the late Emperor and serving Your Majesty with loyalty. As for weighing advantages and disadvantages and offering faithful counsel, that is the responsibility of Youzhi, Yi, and Yun.

　　I pray that Your Majesty will charge me with defeating the rebels and restoring the dynasty. If I fail, punish me for my crimes and inform the spirit of the late Emperor. If no counsel is offered to promote virtue, then rebuke Youzhi, Yi, Yun, and the others for their negligence and make their faults known. Your Majesty should also deliberate for yourself, seek advice on the right course, examine and accept sound counsel, and faithfully uphold the late Emperor's final edict. I am overwhelmed with gratitude for the favor I have received. Now that I must go Away, tears fall as I submit this memorial, and I scarcely know what I have written.

In the spring of the fourth year of the Qingli era@{1}, Teng Zijing was demoted and appointed governor of Baling Prefecture@{2}. By the following year@{3}, the government was efficient, the people were united@{4}, and all neglected endeavors had been revived@{5}. The Yueyang Tower was then renovated@{6} and expanded beyond its former dimensions@{7}, while poems and rhapsodies by eminent Tang poets and contemporary writers were inscribed upon it@{8}. I was asked to write this account in commemoration@{9}.
In my view, the magnificent scenery of Baling@{10} is embodied by Lake Dongting alone. It embraces the distant mountains@{11} and swallows the mighty Yangtze River@{12}, its vast waters surging endlessly@{13} and stretching beyond the horizon@{14}. From morning sunlight to evening shadow, its appearance changes in countless ways@{15}. Such is the grand vista from Yueyang Tower@{16}, which earlier writers have described in full@{17}. Yet with Wu Gorge accessible to the north@{18} and the Xiao and Xiang Rivers extending far to the south@{19}, banished officials and wandering poets@{20} often gather here@{21}. Could their feelings upon viewing this scenery possibly be the same@{22}?
When ceaseless rain falls in dreary sheets@{23} and the sky remains overcast for months on end@{24}, bitter winds howl furiously@{25} and turbid waves surge toward the heavens@{26}. The sun and stars conceal their light@{27}, and the mountains vanish from sight@{28}. Merchants and travelers can go no farther@{29}, while masts topple and oars splinter@{30}. As twilight falls, all is engulfed in darkness@{31}, amid the roars of tigers and cries of apes. Those who ascend the tower then may lament their exile and yearn for home@{32}, fear slander and dread reproach@{33}, and find only desolation wherever they look@{34}, until sorrow overwhelms them@{35}.
But when the spring breeze is gentle and the sunlight bright@{36}, the water lies calm and untroubled@{37}. The radiance of sky and lake meets as one@{38} across a boundless expanse of blue-green. Gulls wheel above the sandbars and come to rest, while shimmering fish swim below@{39}. Angelica grows along the banks and orchids upon the islets@{40}, lush and verdant@{41}. At times, the lingering mist clears completely@{42}, revealing the brilliant moon over a thousand miles@{43}. Its glimmer dances like gold upon the rippling water@{44}, while its still reflection sinks like a jade disc into the depths@{45}. Fishermen's songs echo back and forth@{46}—how could such joy ever end@{47}? The Yueyang Tower was then renovated@{6} and expanded beyond its former dimensions@{7}, while poems and rhapsodies by eminent Tang poets and contemporary writers were inscribed upon it@{8}. I was asked to write this account in commemoration@{9}.

It embraces the distant mountains@{11} and swallows the mighty Yangtze River@{12}, its vast waters surging endlessly@{13} and stretching beyond the horizon@{14}. From morning sunlight to evening shadow, its appearance changes in countless ways@{15}. Such is the grand vista from Yueyang Tower@{16}, which earlier writers have described in full@{17}. Yet with Wu Gorge accessible to the north@{18} and the Xiao and Xiang Rivers extending far to the south@{19}, banished officials and wandering poets@{20} often gather here@{21}. Could their feelings upon viewing this scenery possibly be the same@{22}?
When ceaseless rain falls in dreary sheets@{23} and the sky remains overcast for months on end@{24}, bitter winds howl furiously@{25} and turbid waves surge toward the heavens@{26}. The sun and stars conceal their light@{27}, and the mountains vanish from sight@{28}. Merchants and travelers can go no farther@{29}, while masts topple and oars splinter@{30}. As twilight falls, all is engulfed in darkness@{31}, amid the roars of tigers and cries of apes. But when the spring breeze is gentle and the sunlight bright@{36}, the water lies calm and untroubled@{37}. The radiance of sky and lake meets as one@{38} across a boundless expanse of blue-green. Gulls wheel above the sandbars and come to rest, while shimmering fish swim below@{39}. Angelica grows along the banks and orchids upon the islets@{40}, lush and verdant@{41}. At times, the lingering mist clears completely@{42}, revealing the brilliant moon over a thousand miles@{43}. column2: On the ^{3}oldest stone bridge^{4} in ^{1}Geffen^{2}, examine the joint in the central support beam. A gift lies within a carefully crafted hidden recess.

column2: Beside the bench near the ^{1}Izlude shop^{2}, watch the ^{3}butterflies^{4} that refuse to leave. They seem drawn to an old man's unfinished gift and still flutter there, showing the way.
column3: ข้างม้านั่งใกล้ ^{1}ร้านค้า Izlude^{2} เฝ้าดู ^{3}ผีเสื้อ^{4} ที่ไม่ยอมจากไป ดูเหมือนถูกดึงดูดด้วยของขวัญที่ชายชรายังทำไม่เสร็จ จึงยังบินวนชี้ทางอยู่

column2: In ^{1}Izlude^{2}, the ^{5}small tree^{6} ^{3}outside the Blacksmith shop^{4} has listened to the ringing of hammers for years. They say a master craftsman buried one of his precious "failures" beneath the root closest to the shop.
column3: ใน ^{1}Izlude^{2} ^{5}ต้นไม้เล็ก^{6} ^{3}นอกร้านตีเหล็ก^{4} ฟังเสียงค้อนมานานหลายปี ว่ากันว่าช่างยอดฝีมือฝังหนึ่งใน "ผลงานล้มเหลว" ล้ำค่าไว้ใต้รากที่ใกล้ร้านที่สุด

column2: In ^{1}Izlude's^{2} bustling ^{3}market^{4}, search the most inconspicuous corner of a fruit stall. The shrewd merchant likes to hide his most valuable earnings in the gaps between a pile of Lemons and potatoes.
column3: ใน ^{1}Izlude^{2} ที่ ^{3}ตลาด^{4} พลุกพล่าน ค้นหามุมที่ไม่สะดุดตาที่สุดของแผงผลไม้ พ่อค้าฉลาดชอบซ่อนรายได้ล้ำค่าที่สุดในช่องระหว่างกองเลมอนกับมันฝรั่ง

column2: Beside the ^{3}wooden table^{4} in the southeastern tea pavilion of ^{1}Payon^{2} lies a gift from an elderly tea lover. He left a memento wrapped tightly in oilcloth behind the table leg for a friend who missed their meeting.
column3: ข้าง ^{3}โต๊ะไม้^{4} ในศาลาชามุมตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ของ ^{1}Payon^{2} มีของขวัญจากผู้เฒ่าที่รักชา เขาทิ้งของที่ระลึกห่อผ้าน้ำมันแน่นไว้หลังขาโต๊ะให้เพื่อนที่พลาดนัด

column2: In ^{1}Payon^{2}, head to the ^{3}left side of the open area just inside the courtyard gate^{4}, behind Scholar Biko. A crack in the left boot heel of the ^{5}stone statue^{6} is large enough to conceal a small object. The secret waits there.
column3: ใน ^{1}Payon^{2} ไปที่ ^{3}ด้านซ้ายของลานทันทีที่ผ่านประตูเข้าไป^{4} หลัง Scholar Biko รอยแตกที่ส้นรองเท้าซ้ายของ ^{5}รูปปั้นหิน^{6} ใหญ่พอซ่อนของเล็กๆ ความลับรออยู่ที่นั่น

column2: The ^{1}wooden bridge in Goblin Forest^{2} was once the site of a caravan raid. Amid the chaos, a small pouch of gems rolled away and became lodged in a crack between the planks at the center of the bridge.
column3: ^{1}สะพานไม้ใน Goblin Forest^{2} เคยเป็นจุดที่คาราวานถูกปล้น ระหว่างความโกลาหล ถุงอัญมณีเล็กๆ กลิ้งไปติดรอยแยกระหว่างแผ่นไม้กลางสะพาน

column2: ^{1}Outside Prontera North Gate^{2}, beside the path leading from the North Gate to Labyrinth Forest, the ^{3}dead-tree Dummy directly in front of the dilapidated cabin^{4} stands out. A traveler in a hurry once hid a bag of coins beneath it, but never returned.

column2: Behind the ^{3}bakery visible on your left^{4} ^{1}outside Prontera South Gate^{2}, some stones at the ^{5}base of the city wall^{6} are loose. They say an indebted sailor hid his last bag of silver coins here.

column3: ปล่อยเสียงประสานศักดิ์สิทธิ์ดั้งเดิมทันที ฟื้นฟู HP เท่ากับ M.ATK * ^{1}${3}%^{2} ให้คุณและพันธมิตรสูงสุด ${2} คน ในรัศมี ${1} เมตร (เลือกสมาชิกปาร์ตี้ก่อน) และมอบโล่ดูดซับดาเมจทุกประเภทเท่ากับ M.ATK * ^{3}${4}%^{4} เป็นเวลา ${5} วินาที ขณะมีผล เพิ่มการลดดาเมจที่ได้รับของเป้าหมายขึ้น ^{5}${6}%^{6}

column2: New evil spirit possession—pretend there's a cross behind you.
column3: วิญญาณชั่วร้ายสิงรูปแบบใหม่—ทำเหมือนมีกางเขนอยู่ด้านหลัง

column2: Draw a holy light magic circle with an Exorciser spell, dealing Holy ranged magic damage equal to Magic ATK*^{1}${4}%^{2} to up to ${3} enemies within a ${2}-meter radius within ${1} meters of you. This skill gains one ^{3}Uses:^{4} every ${5} seconds and can stack up to two times.
column3: วาดวงเวทแสงศักดิ์สิทธิ์ด้วยคาถา Exorciser สร้างดาเมจเวทระยะไกลธาตุ Holy เท่ากับ M.ATK*^{1}${4}%^{2} แก่ศัตรูสูงสุด ${3} ตัว ในรัศมี ${2} เมตร ซึ่งอยู่ในระยะ ${1} เมตรจากคุณ สกิลนี้ได้รับ ^{3}จำนวนครั้งที่ใช้ได้:^{4} หนึ่งครั้งทุก ${5} วินาที สะสมสูงสุดสองครั้ง

column2: When Highness Heal HITs an allied target, it triggers 【Equal Blessing】, chaining to @{2} targets within @{1} meters of the target. If a chained target is a party Member, they receive Extra healing.
column3: เมื่อ Highness Heal โจมตีโดนเป้าหมายพันธมิตร ทำให้เกิด [ Equal Blessing ] เชื่อมต่อถึงเป้าหมาย @{2} คน ในระยะ @{1} เมตรรอบเป้าหมาย หากเป้าหมายที่เชื่อมเป็นสมาชิกปาร์ตี้ จะได้รับฮีลเพิ่มเติม

column2: Every @{1} casts, Highness Heal will Level-up into 【Manifestation】. When cast, it manifests a shattered Orbit and chains once to up to @{3} allies within @{2} meters of the target. If a chained target is a party Member, they receive Extra healing.
column3: ทุกการใช้ @{1} ครั้ง Highness Heal จะยกระดับเป็น [ Manifestation ] เมื่อใช้ สร้างวงโคจรแตกสลายและเชื่อมต่อหนึ่งครั้งถึงพันธมิตรสูงสุด @{3} คน ในระยะ @{2} เมตรรอบเป้าหมาย หากเป้าหมายที่เชื่อมเป็นสมาชิกปาร์ตี้ จะได้รับฮีลเพิ่มเติม

column2: For @{1}s after casting [Radiant Holy Light], Manifestation shatters Orbit. During this time, the next @{2} casts of Highness Heal summon translucent petals, restoring Life to allies within @{3}m of you.
column3: ภายใน @{1} วินาทีหลังใช้ [ Radiant Holy Light ] Manifestation ทำลายวงโคจร ระหว่างนี้ การใช้ Highness Heal @{2} ครั้งถัดไปจะเรียกกลีบดอกไม้โปร่งแสง ฟื้นฟู HP ให้พันธมิตรในระยะ @{3} เมตรรอบตัวคุณ

column2: 【Brilliant Holy Light】can be Enhanced into 【Angel Incarnate】, reducing its Cooldown. Upon casting, transform into an Angel of Divine Light and convert Highness Heal into 【Manifestation】 for @{1}s. During this time, gain damage reduction and bonus Move SPD, float, and cast while moving.
column3: [ Brilliant Holy Light ] สามารถเสริมพลังเป็น [ Angel Incarnate ] ลด Cooldown เมื่อใช้ แปลงร่างเป็น Angel of Divine Light และเปลี่ยน Highness Heal เป็น [ Manifestation ] เป็นเวลา @{1} วินาที ระหว่างนี้ ได้รับการลดดาเมจและโบนัส MSPD ลอยตัว และร่ายขณะเคลื่อนที่ได้

column2: 【Judex】transforms into 【Enlightenment】, gaining enhanced visuals and increased damage. When cast, it deals one instance of Extra ST damage to up to @{2} enemies within @{1} meters of the target.\n【Second Holy Light】transforms into 【Interwoven Light and Shadow】 and has a Chance to be triggered by the initial hit of 【Enlightenment】, dealing Physical or Magic damage. While in 【Divine Stance】, the trigger Chance becomes @{3}%.
column3: [ Judex ] เปลี่ยนเป็น [ Enlightenment ] พร้อมเอฟเฟกต์ภาพที่ดีขึ้นและดาเมจเพิ่มขึ้น เมื่อใช้ จะสร้างดาเมจ Single Target เพิ่มอีกหนึ่งครั้งแก่ศัตรูสูงสุด @{2} ตัว ในระยะ @{1} เมตรรอบเป้าหมาย\n[ Second Holy Light ] เปลี่ยนเป็น [ Interwoven Light and Shadow ] และมีโอกาสเกิดผลจากการโจมตีครั้งแรกของ [ Enlightenment ] สร้างดาเมจกายภาพหรือเวท ขณะอยู่ใน [ Divine Stance ] โอกาสเกิดผลจะเป็น @{3}%

column2: Every @{1} casts of 【Enlightenment】 causes all targets HIT to take damage again and increases your Move Speed.\nThe Extra damage sends a wisp of 【Will】 back to you, restoring a charge of 【Stigma】.
column3: ทุกการใช้ [ Enlightenment ] @{1} ครั้ง ทำให้เป้าหมายทั้งหมดที่ถูกโจมตีได้รับดาเมจอีกครั้งและเพิ่ม MSPD ของคุณ\nดาเมจเพิ่มเติมส่งเสี้ยว [ Will ] กลับมาหาคุณ ฟื้นฟู [ Stigma ] หนึ่งชาร์จ

column2: @{1}. 【Stigma】transforms into 【Blackwing Burst】, gaining improved effects and increased damage.\n@{2}. When 【Blackwing Burst】 has two charges, it gains Enhance. Casting it consumes both charges at once, dealing skill damage twice, with a larger area on the second hit.\n@{3}. 【Divine Retribution】 transforms into 【Demonic Judgment】. After casting, automatically casts 【Blackwing Burst】 at the target location.
column3: @{1}. [ Stigma ] เปลี่ยนเป็น [ Blackwing Burst ] ได้รับเอฟเฟกต์ที่ดีขึ้นและดาเมจเพิ่มขึ้น\n@{2}. เมื่อ [ Blackwing Burst ] มีสองชาร์จ ได้รับการเสริมพลัง ใช้ทั้งสองชาร์จพร้อมกันเพื่อสร้างดาเมจสกิลสองครั้ง โดยครั้งที่สองมีพื้นที่กว้างขึ้น\n@{3}. [ Divine Retribution ] เปลี่ยนเป็น [ Demonic Judgment ] หลังใช้ จะใช้ [ Blackwing Burst ] ที่ตำแหน่งเป้าหมายอัตโนมัติ

column2: 【Holy Spirit Surge】 becomes 【Evil Spirit Possession】. When activated, you enter the 【Embrace of Sin】 state, raising a cross behind you that launches a coordinated attack whenever you deal damage. (Cooldown: @{1}s)\nWhen the coordinated attack scores a HIT, a wisp of 【Will】 flies back and restores charge to 【Stigmata】.
column3: [ Holy Spirit Surge ] เปลี่ยนเป็น [ Evil Spirit Possession ] เมื่อเปิดใช้ เข้าสู่สถานะ [ Embrace of Sin ] ยกกางเขนขึ้นด้านหลังเพื่อโจมตีประสานทุกครั้งที่คุณสร้างดาเมจ (Cooldown: @{1} วินาที)\nเมื่อการโจมตีประสานโจมตีโดน เศษเสี้ยว [ Will ] จะบินกลับมาเติมชาร์จให้ [ Stigmata ]

column2: You spin your battle axe to create a hurricane filled with axe trails. Targets hit are inflicted with ${1} stacks of ${2}% Slow (cannot stack) for ${3} seconds. The hurricane deals ${6} instances of ${7}% Physical damage to up to ${5} enemies within a ${4}-meter radius. Each instance that hits ${8} targets grants you ${9} stacks of 【Blade Mark】.
column3: หมุนขวานรบสร้างพายุที่เต็มไปด้วยรอยขวาน เป้าหมายที่ถูกโจมตีได้รับ Slow ${1} stacks ลดความเร็ว ${2}% (สะสมไม่ได้) เป็นเวลา ${3} วินาที พายุสร้างดาเมจกายภาพ ${6} ครั้ง เท่ากับ ${7}% แก่ศัตรูสูงสุด ${5} ตัว ในรัศมี ${4} เมตร แต่ละครั้งที่โจมตีโดน ${8} เป้าหมายมอบ [ Blade Mark ] ${9} stacks ให้คุณ

column2: Can only be used while riding a Madogear Pilot. Mount ${1} cannons on its shoulders and Launch ${6} shells at ${3} designated enemies within ${2} meters and up to ${5} other enemies within ${4} meters of them, dealing total Neutral ranged Physical damage equal to Physical ATK*^{1}${7}%^{2}.
column3: ใช้ได้เฉพาะขณะขี่ Madogear Pilot ติดปืนใหญ่ ${1} กระบอกบนไหล่ ยิงกระสุน ${6} นัดใส่ศัตรูที่กำหนด ${3} ตัว ในระยะ ${2} เมตร และศัตรูอื่นสูงสุด ${5} ตัว ในระยะ ${4} เมตรรอบศัตรูเหล่านั้น สร้างดาเมจกายภาพระยะไกลธาตุ Neutral รวมเท่ากับ P.ATK*^{1}${7}%^{2}

column2: Bombards a ${1} m * ${2} m area in the designated direction, continuously dealing Physical ATK * ^{1}${4}%^{2} Neutral ranged Physical DMG to up to ${3} enemies along the path and increasing Movement Speed by ^{3}${5}%^{4} for the skill's duration.
